text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes... My skin has been breaking out a bit,
but other than that, I'm doing well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's not something serious enough
to see a doctor over.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, no, you must be busy too, Mother, so there's no need for you to come all the way to the academy――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Running there would make for great training!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just the thought is more than enough...!
All right then, I'll leave it in your capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mother seems as energetic as ever...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I forgot to ask them
to send me some lotion...
